```{r load-packages, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(shiny)
library(rmapshaper)
library(DT)
library(sf)
library(htmltools)
library(leafsync)

library(gt)
library(sf)
library(viridis)

river_coords <- read_csv("~/FishyG/data/survey_sites_vancouver_isl.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
river_coords <- river_coords %>%
  mutate(model = case_when(
    stream_name_pse %in% c("NANAIMO RIVER", "COWICHAN RIVER", "LITTLE QUALICUM RIVER", "CHEMAINUS RIVER") ~ "Model", TRUE ~"No model"
  ))
```

```{r}
pal <- colorFactor(c("#1b9e77", "#7570b3", "darkgrey"), domain = river_coords$model)

leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(data = river_coords, ~longitude, ~latitude,
                   fillColor = ~pal(model),
                   fillOpacity = 0.9,
                   stroke = FALSE,
                   radius = 6)
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r}
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Site Map"),
  leafletOutput("map", height = 600)
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    leaflet() %>% 
      addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap) %>%
      addCircleMarkers(data = river_coords, ~longitude, ~latitude,
                   fillColor = ~pal(model),
                   fillOpacity = 0.9,
                   stroke = FALSE,
                   radius = 6)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
